#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "=== Installing required packages ==="
apt-get update
apt-get install -y git openssh-server openssh-client nginx openssl

echo "=== Creating git user ==="
if ! id -u git > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    useradd -m -s /bin/bash git
fi

echo "=== Setting git user password ==="
echo "git:password" | chpasswd

echo "=== Creating git repository directory ==="
mkdir -p /git
chown git:git /git
chmod 755 /git

echo "=== Creating bare repository ==="
mkdir -p /git/project.git
cd /git/project.git
git init --bare
chown -R git:git /git/project.git
chmod -R 755 /git/project.git

echo "=== Creating deployment directories ==="
mkdir -p /var/www/main
mkdir -p /var/www/dev
chown -R git:git /var/www/main /var/www/dev
chmod -R 755 /var/www/main /var/www/dev

echo "=== Creating post-receive hook ==="
cat > /git/project.git/hooks/post-receive << 'HOOK_EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Read stdin (contains ref info from git push)
while read oldrev newrev refname; do
    branch=$(basename "$refname")

    if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then
        deploy_dir="/var/www/main"
    elif [ "$branch" = "dev" ]; then
        deploy_dir="/var/www/dev"
    else
        continue
    fi

    echo "Deploying $branch to $deploy_dir"

    # Create temp directory for checkout
    temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
    trap "rm -rf $temp_dir" EXIT

    # Export git repository content
    git --work-tree="$temp_dir" checkout -f "$branch"

    # Clear and deploy
    rm -rf "$deploy_dir"/*
    cp -r "$temp_dir"/* "$deploy_dir"/ 2>/dev/null || true

    echo "Deployment of $branch completed"
done
HOOK_EOF

chmod +x /git/project.git/hooks/post-receive
chown git:git /git/project.git/hooks/post-receive

echo "=== Configuring SSH ==="
# Enable password authentication
sed -i 's/^#PasswordAuthentication no/PasswordAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
sed -i 's/^PasswordAuthentication no/PasswordAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config

# Create SSH directory if needed
mkdir -p /run/sshd

# Restart SSH service
service ssh restart || sshd -D &
sleep 1

echo "=== Creating self-signed certificate ==="
mkdir -p /etc/nginx/ssl
openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \
    -keyout /etc/nginx/ssl/nginx.key \
    -out /etc/nginx/ssl/nginx.crt \
    -subj "/C=US/ST=State/L=City/O=Org/CN=localhost"

echo "=== Configuring Nginx ==="
cat > /etc/nginx/sites-available/default << 'NGINX_EOF'
server {
    listen 8443 ssl;
    server_name localhost;

    ssl_certificate /etc/nginx/ssl/nginx.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/nginx.key;

    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;

    # Main branch at root
    location / {
        root /var/www/main;
        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
    }

    # Dev branch at /dev
    location /dev {
        alias /var/www/dev;
        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
    }
}
NGINX_EOF

# Remove default sites-enabled if exists
rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default

# Create symlink if not exists
if [ ! -L /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default ]; then
    ln -s /etc/nginx/sites-available/default /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
fi

# Test nginx configuration
nginx -t

# Restart nginx
service nginx restart || nginx -g 'daemon off;' &
sleep 2

echo "=== Setup Complete ==="
echo "Git server ready at: ssh://git@localhost/git/project"
echo "Web server ready at: https://localhost:8443"
echo "Credentials: git / password"

set -e

echo "=== Testing Git Server Setup ==="

# Create a temporary directory for testing

# Git Server Setup with HTTPS Deployment

This is a complete Git server setup that:
- Hosts a Git repository over SSH at `git@localhost:/git/project`
- Accepts password authentication (`password: "password"`)
- Automatically deploys content from the `main` and `dev` branches to HTTPS endpoints using Nginx
- Uses self-signed SSL/TLS certificates for HTTPS

## Setup

All setup is automated via `/app/setup.sh`:

```bash
chmod +x /app/setup.sh
/app/setup.sh
```

This script:
1. Installs Git, OpenSSH, Nginx, and OpenSSL
2. Creates a `git` user with password authentication enabled
3. Creates a bare Git repository at `/git/project.git`
4. Installs a `post-receive` hook for automatic deployment
5. Generates a self-signed SSL certificate
6. Configures Nginx to serve the branches over HTTPS

## Repository Access

**SSH Clone:**
```bash
git clone git@localhost:/git/project
```

**Authentication:**
- Username: `git`
- Password: `password`

To make password entry automatic, install `sshpass`:
```bash
apt-get install sshpass
export GIT_SSH="/path/to/ssh_wrapper.sh"  # See test.sh for example
```

## Deployment

When you push to a branch, the `post-receive` hook automatically:
1. Checks out the pushed branch
2. Copies the content to `/var/www/main` (for main branch) or `/var/www/dev` (for dev branch)
3. Completes within 3 seconds

## HTTPS Endpoints

- **Main branch:** https://localhost:8443/index.html
- **Dev branch:** https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html

**Note:** Use `curl -k` to skip certificate verification on self-signed certs:
```bash
curl -k https://localhost:8443/index.html
curl -k https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html
```

## SSL Certificate Details

- Location: `/etc/nginx/ssl/nginx.crt` and `/etc/nginx/ssl/nginx.key`
- Type: Self-signed
- Valid for: 365 days
- CN: localhost
